Name: Save Anywhere V3
Author: ShuaiZhang
Description:
This is a completely rewrited mod to "SaveAnywhere" by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/32171640]Omegasis[/url].

The mod add more features than the Omegasis's one.
[list]
[*]Auto load (No more walking needed to trigger the loading)
[*]Load anywhere (Press 'K' to save, press 'L' to load)
[*]Do not force shipping items calculated, leave it to normal saving.

[/list]
[b]For StardewValley v1.11 and [url=https://github.com/cjsu/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI v[/url]1.6+

If you have issues, double-check that you have the lastest version of SMAPI.

Source: https://github.com/hcoona/StardewValleyMods
Bug Report: https://github.com/hcoona/StardewValleyMods/issues[/b]
